request.description: Update a property listing (Landlord only, must own the property)
Delete a property (Landlord only, must own the property, cannot delete if active tenancies exist)
Retrieve all listings owned by the authenticated landlord (Landlord only)
Toggle the availability status of a property (Landlord only, must own the property)
Retrieve all photos for a property, ordered by sort_order
Upload a new photo for a property (Landlord only, must own the property)
Delete a photo from a property (Landlord only, must own the property)
Retrieve all properties saved by the authenticated tenant (Tenant only)
Toggle saving/unsaving a property for the authenticated tenant (Tenant only)
List applications visible to the authenticated user. Use a tenant token to see tenant applications or a landlord token to see applications for owned properties.
Submit a new application as a tenant.
Retrieve a single application as the tenant or the property owner landlord.
Accept an application as the owning landlord. This should create an agreement automatically.
Reject an application as the owning landlord.
Withdraw a pending application as the tenant who submitted it.
List agreements visible to the authenticated user. Use a tenant token to see tenant agreements or a landlord token to see landlord agreements.
Retrieve a single agreement as either the tenant or landlord.
Mark the agreement acknowledged as the tenant.
Mark the agreement acknowledged as the landlord.
Terminate an active agreement as either the tenant or landlord.

item.name: Backend API
item.description: Backend-only collection for agreements. In a production setup, frontend tests would live in a separate collection or runner and call the same endpoints through environment variables.

request.description: List agreements visible to the authenticated tenant.
Retrieve an agreement as the tenant.
Mark the agreement acknowledged as the tenant.
Terminate an active agreement as the tenant.
List agreements visible to the authenticated landlord.
Retrieve an agreement as the landlord.
Mark the agreement acknowledged as the landlord.
Terminate an active agreement as the landlord.
List rent payments for the authenticated tenant or landlord. Optionally filter by agreement_id.
Record a manual rent payment. Tenants only.
Retrieve a single rent payment record.
Get total paid, late fees, count, and latest payment info for a tenant agreement.
Create an eSewa payment log and get form data for redirecting to eSewa.
Verify the callback payload returned by eSewa after payment completion.
List maintenance requests visible to the authenticated tenant or landlord. Optional status filter.

formdata.value: Water is leaking under the sink and needs urgent repair.

request.description: Create a maintenance request as a tenant. Supports uploading multiple images using repeated images fields.
Retrieve a single maintenance ticket if the authenticated user has access.
Tenants can update pending requests; landlords can update status and priority.
Landlords can move a ticket through pending, in_progress, resolved, or cancelled and adjust priority.
List inspections visible to the authenticated tenant or landlord.
Create a move-out inspection report. Landlords or admins only.
Retrieve a single inspection report if the authenticated user is related to the agreement.
Update an inspection report before finalization. Landlords or admins only.
Finalize the inspection. Finalization should trigger the agreement transition workflow.
List notices visible to the authenticated user. Optional agreement_id and notice_type filters can be enabled in the query string.
